_README: Controls no e2e suite presses, each with the reason. This list is a RATCHET: it is seeded with what was untested when the audit was added, so it does not demand retroactive coverage — but a control added later has no entry, so CI fails until someone tests it or writes down why not. Deleting an entry and adding coverage is always the better move. src/controlcoverage.test.ts also fails on a STALE entry, so a renamed control cannot keep a reason that no longer protects anything.
Cancel: Dismisses a dialog without side effects; failure is visible immediately and harms nothing.
Close Dialog: Same. NOTE: this and 'Close dialog' both exist — the app spells the same aria-label two ways, which is worth unifying.
Close menu: Menu chrome, no state beyond visibility.
Close tour: The tour's own X. Every suite dismisses the tour via the viewport-anchored 'Exit tour' instead, because this one follows the spotlight and step 1's smooth-scroll can leave it off-screen — that is a known e2e flake root cause, not an oversight.
Done: Dialog chrome: dismisses without side effects, and failure is visible immediately.
Skip: Tour chrome; the tour is dismissed wholesale by every suite.
Log out: Token invalidation is covered end to end by src/integration/api.test.mjs against the real server, which is a stronger test than clicking the control that triggers it.
Increase x\u2080: The x0/y0 steppers. The VALUE path they drive is covered — smoke types into x0 and asserts the log opens at 'Start (0.000, …)', and the mobile suite asserts these meet the 24px WCAG 2.2 AA floor after they were found at 25x20. What is untested is the increment arithmetic itself.
Send feedback: Deliberately never clicked: it sends real email through SMTP. Exercising it would either need a live mail path in CI or a stub of the one thing the control exists to do.
Prefer the terminal?: Informational link-style control; navigates, holds no state.
Refresh: Re-fetches the saved-game list; the list endpoint itself is covered by the integration suite.
Open workspace menu: Reveals the saved-game library. UNTESTED AND WORTH TESTING — this is the surface that renders user-saved descriptions, which is exactly where a colour-coding or escaping defect would show.
Get the desktop app: Starts a DMG download from GCS. Not clicked in CI because the download itself is the thing it does; the release pipeline covers producing and uploading that artifact.
Sign In / Sign Up: Opens the auth panel. The auth LIFECYCLE — register, verify, login, tampered tokens, rate limits — is covered by src/integration/api.test.mjs against the real server.
